ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
// 移除正文开头前两行的冗余内容
result = result.replace(/^(.*\n){2}/, "");

// 转义标题变量中的特殊字符，确保正则安全
let safeTitle = title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

// 根据标题长度动态匹配并清理正文中的重复标题行
if (title.length < 5) {
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${safeTitle}\\s*\\n`, "i"), "");
} else {
    let shortTitle = safeTitle.substr(0, Math.floor(safeTitle.length * 2 / 3));
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${shortTitle}.*\\n`, "i"), "");
}

// 匹配并移除以“第X章”开头的特征行，防止章节名残留
result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`, "i"), "");

// 清理文末各种括号格式的“本章完”字样
result = result.replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/g, "");

result;
</js>

ruleSearch.author: div.newbox>ul>li>div.newnav>div.labelbox>label:first-of-type@text
ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
let option = {
    "charset": "gbk",
    "method": "POST",
    "body": `searchkey=${java.get("searchkey")}&submit=Search`
};

let isVerified = result.includes("Just a moment...") || result.includes("onloadTurnstileCallback");
let isTooFast = result.includes("搜索的间隔时间");

if (isVerified) {
    java.toast("❗身份验证过期");
    let freshUrl = `${baseUrl}${baseUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}_t=${Date.now()}`;
    java.startBrowserAwait(freshUrl, "Authentication");
    result = java.ajax(`${baseUrl},${JSON.stringify(option)}`);
} else if (isTooFast) {
    java.toast("❗搜索过于频繁");
    Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(5000);
    result = java.ajax(`${baseUrl},${JSON.stringify(option)}`);
} else {
    result = result;
}
</js>
